name: Suma Haruto
source:
"I don't need a world where I can't sing about my 'feelings' for you."

The guitarist and vocalist with a passionate heart. At Eisuke's suggestion, they teamed up with the government in order to have their music recognized.

He is blunt but polite, and looks straight into people's eyes when he speaks, making both men and women fall in love with him. He loves animals and wants to take care of Otto the cat, but for some reason, he is sad that Otto hates him.

[Translated from [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/live/original/character/suma_haruto.html]official website[/url]]
